The Process of Making an AI Robot That Draws Your Portrait in Just 1 Minute

Hello, this is King Process.
In this video, we follow the making of Sketcher X, an AI robot that analyzes a person’s face and draws their portrait in about one minute.
We filmed the entire process, from building and testing the robot at the XORBiS office in Korea to designing and installing the digital experience space for NEXT IDOL Your K-POP Moment in Singapore.
The robot parts were shipped from Korea by sea and assembled again on site in Singapore. The team also installed and tested the video and audio equipment, large monitors, and ceiling lighting to complete the space.
You can also see the AI robot talking with visitors while drawing their portraits, a fortune-telling robot that communicates by phone, and the finished digital experience space.
We hope you enjoy the video.
Thank you for watching King Process. Please subscribe, like, and leave a comment.
